Membership can come from a Group document you store on the host, the identity provider's roles, or the built-in groups. on the expression — it travels in the request body instead of a header. It is safe, idempotent, and cacheable, following the IETF draft draft-ietf-httpbis-safe-method-w-body. QUERY accepts two request content types, which select entirely different behavior: text/css-selector — a CSS selector, returning every matching element as a multipart/mixed response. Served by the WebDAV authoring server, and (for a single document) by the edge proxy. text/sessel — a Sessel expression, evaluated against a document. Served by the edge proxy. Servers advertise the content types a resource accepts on OPTIONS responses via the Accept-Query header.
